Reports.title: 报告
Reports.description: 查看学生进度和课堂分析

description.A0: 您可以识别您以前见过的单词和名称，尤其是在有图片帮助的情况下。您可以理解您周围的真实简单的标志和基本信息，如在哪里和什么时候发生什么事情。
description.A1-: 您开始识别更多的单词和简单的短语，超越了最基本的词汇。您可以遵循短、简单的方向，并理解基本的短语和句子，关于您需要的事情。
description.A1: 您可以理解非常短和简单的文本。您可以识别足够的单词来发现它们在通知和简单指南中的位置。您可以使用您知道的单词谈论简单、日常的事情。
description.A1+: 您开始理解对您重要的句子表达。阅读不仅仅是识别熟悉的单词；您开始理解简单的文本中的整个信息。
description.A2-: 您在理解简单文本方面做得更好，可以在日常材料中找到特定信息，如广告或时间表，尽管您可能仍然对不熟悉的主题感到困惑。
description.A2: 您可以理解短、简单的文本，在日常材料中找到您需要的信息，如广告或菜单，并遵循基本指令。您知道足够的单词来在日常情况下沟通。
description.A2+: 您可以理解常规写作和短新闻故事或描述的主要观点。您的词汇量在增长，因此您可以谈论对您重要的事情，并处理日常情况。
description.B1-: 您可以理解熟悉主题的直接文本的主要观点。您正在发展处理介绍新主题或稍微更复杂语言的文本的能力，尽管您可能仍然需要一些帮助。
description.B1: 您可以阅读您喜欢的主题的文本，并理解主要观点。故事和个人信息对您来说很容易理解。您知道足够的单词用于日常主题，并且可以谈论您阅读的内容，不会遇到太多困难。
description.B1+: 您可以理解关于熟悉主题的清晰写作，并且处理稍微更复杂的语言的能力有所提高。您可以轻松找到您需要的信息，并且可以享受一本不太困难的书籍。
description.B2-: 您可以理解关于熟悉主题的详细文本。您开始识别语言的微妙部分，并且可以轻松讨论您感兴趣的主题，尽管非常复杂的想法可能仍然具有挑战性。
description.B2: 您可以独立阅读并判断文本是正式还是非正式。您可以根据您正在阅读的内容调整阅读速度。您喜欢关于当前事件的好书和文章。您知道很多单词，即使有时您会感到困惑，您通常也能弄清楚。
description.B2+: 您可以理解更具挑战性文本的主要观点，如科学文章或更复杂的故事。您开始更多地独立阅读，并且可以处理抽象或技术性主题，特别是您熟悉的主题。
description.C1-: 您可以通过一些努力理解复杂文本。您的词汇量使您可以阅读许多不同的主题，并且您可以弄清楚不太明显的细节，尽管有时您可能需要重新阅读某些部分。
description.C1: 您可以阅读长而具有挑战性的文本并理解大部分发生的事情。您喜欢让您思考的故事和文章，并且可以使用良好的词汇谈论它们，而无需太费力地查找正确的单词。
description.C1+: 您是一个超级读者，可以处理具有挑战性的文本并理解不同的写作风格。您非常擅长弄清楚故事和文章中不太明显的部分，并且通常知道单词的意思，而无需查找它们。
description.C2: 您可以阅读和理解几乎任何事情。您可以理解复杂文本的主要观点，并且喜欢阅读更具挑战性的书籍和文章。您可以谈论几乎任何事情，并且使用语言充满信心。
description.A0-: 你刚开始学英语。你认识一些字母和几个单词，尤其是有图片的单词。
description.A0+: 你认识更多简单的单词和名字。你能看懂配有图片的很短的短语，比如标志和标签。

meta.title: Primary Advantage | English workbooks and a reading app for grades 3–6
meta.description: Primary Advantage pairs printed English workbooks with a reading app for grades 3–6. CEFR-aligned levels, a game world around the reading, and tools for Thai teachers.

hero.title: Primary Advantage
hero.tagline: Read the book in class. Continue the adventure in the app.
hero.phoneAlt: The Primary Advantage home page on a phone: the student's hero in the guild hall, with the day streak, XP, and level signs and the Class Quest banner

book.title: The book and the app
book.body: Each Primary Advantage workbook has 14 lessons. The app has the same lessons, with audio, pictures, and practice. Students read the printed book in class and continue in the app.
book.mockupAlt: The cover of the Primary Advantage Origins 3.2 workbook
book.classBookAlt: The class book on a phone: Primary Advantage Origins 2, with lesson 1 marked "Now in class"
book.classBookCaption: In the app: the class book for Primary Advantage Origins 2

inside.title: Inside the app
inside.intro: Every page of the app is a place in Chibi Quest, a picture-book game world. The story page stays plain, so the reading comes first.

hero.title: Choose a hero
hero.body: Each student chooses a hero, then picks its skin, hair, eye, and clothes colors.
hero.alt: The hero shrine on desktop: the hero classes stand on stones, each with a name sign

shop.title: Earn GP, choose gear
shop.body: Students earn Guild Points (GP) when they read and practice. They spend GP on gear for their hero in the shop. GP cannot be bought with money.
shop.alt: The avatar shop on a phone: gear with GP prices, and the bracers marked "Owned" after the student buys them

quest.title: Class Quest: one boss, the whole class
quest.body: During the week, students meet reading goals to earn power-ups. Then the whole class fights one boss together on the classroom projector. There is no leaderboard and no ranking.
quest.alt: Class Quest on a phone: the Goblin King, the class damage meter, and the student's hero with five hearts

reedy.title: Reedy Preview: speaking practice
reedy.body: After a lesson, students talk about the story with Reedy, a speaking coach, in English and Thai. Reedy is new, so it can make mistakes. Each student has a monthly time limit.
reedy.alt: Reedy Preview on a phone: the student's Wizard hero at the campfire, the minutes meter, and the Preview label

wordAdventures.title: Word adventures
wordAdventures.body: Games that use the words and sentences each student saved from their reading. A 2D mode runs on older phones.
wordAdventures.alt: Word adventures on desktop: game cards for Rune Match, Labyrinth of the Goblin King, Potion Rush, and Dragon Flight

teachers.title: For teachers
teachers.body: Designed for Thai teachers. Each lesson has a step-by-step plan in the Teacher manual, so you always know what to do next.
points: Open each lesson for the class when you teach it from the workbook.
Show the lesson and the Class Quest battle on the classroom projector.
See each student's progress, lesson by lesson, and who needs help.
teachers.alt: The class progress page on desktop: each student's lessons, with a mark on the students who need help

levels.title: Levels
levels.body: Primary Advantage is CEFR-aligned, with 15 levels from Pre-A1 (A0) to B2. Each CEFR band has three levels, so students move up in small steps.

families.title: For families
families.body: Children can also learn with the same books outside school. In Tutor Advantage, a local tutor teaches the class, and one class package uses one workbook.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.body: Schools: ask us for a free trial or a demo. Families: ask us about Tutor Advantage classes.
contact.lineQrAlt: QR code for the Reading Advantage LINE Official Account

meta.title: About us | Primary Advantage
meta.description: Reading Advantage (Thailand) is a curriculum publisher in Khon Kaen. We make Primary Advantage: printed English workbooks and a reading app for grades 3–6.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Reading Advantage (Thailand) is a curriculum publisher in Khon Kaen. Phikul Phookathin and Daniel Bo started the company in January 2024. We make printed English workbooks and matching apps for Thai schools and families.

product.title: What Primary Advantage is
product.body: Primary Advantage is English reading for grades 3–6 (ages 8–11). Each workbook has 14 lessons with stories and informational texts, new words, questions, and writing, and the app has the same lessons. Every article, question, and word is being tagged to Mastery Advantage, our map of English skills. The method is extensive reading. Research shows extensive reading outperforms traditional grammar instruction (Aka, 2019).

schools.title: For schools: Blended Learning
schools.body: Schools use Primary Advantage through Blended Learning: printed workbooks and the app, with teacher training and step-by-step lesson plans. The lesson plans assume the teacher is a fluent Thai speaker, not a native English teacher.

families.title: For families: Tutor Advantage
families.body: Families can learn with the same books through Tutor Advantage. A local tutor teaches the class, and one class package uses one workbook.

meta.title: Contact us | Primary Advantage
meta.description: Contact Reading Advantage about Primary Advantage: a free trial or a demo for your school, or Tutor Advantage classes for your child.

PublicContact.title: Contact us
PublicContact.intro: Schools can ask for a free trial or a demo. Families can ask about Tutor Advantage classes. Send us a message on LINE or Facebook, call us, or send an email.
PublicContact.lineQrAlt: QR code for the Reading Advantage LINE Official Account

meta.title: Our books | Primary Advantage
meta.description: The Primary Advantage workbook series: Origins, Quest, and Adventure. Written and edited by the Reading Advantage team in Khon Kaen.

PublicBooks.title: Our books
PublicBooks.intro: Primary Advantage is a series of printed English workbooks for grades 3–6. Each book has 14 lessons, and the app has the same lessons. The series follows the CEFR levels.

origins.title: Primary Advantage Origins
origins.body: Pre-A1 (A0). First stories and short informational texts about school, family, friends, and the world around them. Primary Advantage Origins 2 and Primary Advantage Origins 3.1 are in print. Primary Advantage Origins 3.2 is next.

quest.title: Primary Advantage Quest
quest.body: A1. Longer stories and texts, with new words in each lesson, for students who can read simple English. Primary Advantage Quest 4 is the first Quest book in preparation.

adventure.title: Primary Advantage Adventure
adventure.body: A2. Stories and informational texts for students who read with more confidence. The Adventure books are planned.

team.title: Who makes the books
team.body: The Reading Advantage team in Khon Kaen writes and edits every book. The founders lead the team: Phikul Phookathin (President; M.Ed., Educational Leadership) and Daniel Bo (Product Manager). Together they have 40 years of teaching experience.
